summary: Separate MCP events from gateway events
description: SEC-31. Gateway events use source gateway. MCP events use source mcp. A service key cannot read stats. MCP events stop after the configured count.
scope: The two sources are gateway and mcp
A service key gets 403 on stats and the 101st MCP event is rejected

Do not let an MCP event overwrite a gateway total.
Do not drop the source field when it is present.
